title: Database disk full due to export job
alert: Customers can browse the product catalog but receive an error when trying to place an order.

truth.root_cause: An export job that runs every minute writes large database dumps to the PostgreSQL data directory, filling the disk and blocking write operations.
truth.fix: Move the oldest export file to another disk to free space, disable the export job, then verify that orders succeed again.

recent_changes: Added export job that runs every minute to dump database to /var/lib/postgresql/exports
